svg.title: Veydria Continental Schematic: Spatial Reference Map
svg.desc: Schematic derived from geography/continents/veydria-climate-spine.md, veydria-topology.yaml and geography/edges/. Not an art map: a reference for spatial relationships. C-shaped continent open to the west, six civilizations, the Aethelian Basin, five trade routes plus the Copper-for-Steel treaty flow.
